# ubiops_service_user_token (Resource)

Manages a UbiOps service user API token. The token value is only available at creation time.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ubiops_service_user_token" "example" {
  project_name    = "my-project"
  service_user_id = ubiops_service_user.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_name` (String) The name of the project.
- `service_user_id` (String) The UUID of the service user.

### Read-Only

- `token` (String, Sensitive) The new API token for the service user
